Subject: Renewal onboarding: procurement portal kick & SOW amendment

Hi Maya —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I wanted to kick off the procurement path so we don't hit the approval lag at renewal. Quick summary and asks: 

- We agreed on the 12-month renewal with a 20% capacity uplift (estimate: 4 reserved GPUs -> 5) and a small SOW amendment to reflect the uplift and updated SLAs.
- Can your procurement team share the PO template and the preferred DocuSign/contract routing?
- You mentioned a vendor onboarding portal — please share the link and the list of required evidence (SOC 2, encryption attestation, data retention policy).

I'll pull together the SOC 2 summary and a curated evidence bundle for the portal. If you prefer, we can send the SOW amendment for signature this week to lock terms ahead of the finance calendar.

Next step: If I get the PO template and portal URL today, I can upload evidence and push the DocuSign send by Friday.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124

Thanks Ben — appreciate the clear summary. A few items from our side: 

- Please upload: SOC 2 Type II summary, data processing addendum, encryption-at-rest attestation, and a short manifest of who will access logs (we have an internal audit).
- Our procurement portal is here: https://procure.cobalthealth.com/vendor-onboard/Redwood-Inference (you'll need to register with your corporate email). Once registered, upload the evidence and the completed PO template.
- PO template attached (see filename: Cobalt_Renewal_PO_template.xlsx). Our legal asks for a redline of any SOW changes and an explicit capacity line item.

Can you confirm: will the capacity uplift be billed as a one-time commit or phased monthly increases? Finance prefers a one-line PO for this renewal to avoid multiple POs.

Best,

Forwarding Maya's note. Key asks for our playbook: 

1) Evidence bundle: SOC 2 summary (one-pager), DPA, encryption attestation, access manifest. Can you compile the evidence bundle and a short README that maps doc -> portal field? Aim: single ZIP that matches the procurement portal requirements.

2) SOW amendment: Ben, we'll prepare a redline with a capacity line item and billing model. Finance prefers a single PO; recommend we present the uplift as "Committed capacity (one-time term modification)" with annualized cost and monthly rate shown for transparency.

3) Timeline: if we can finalize the redline by Tue 10/27 and upload evidence to the portal the same day, Maya's team said they can run approvals the week of 11/1. That hits their renewal window.

Please see the quoted text from Maya below: 
> "Our procurement portal is here: https://procure.cobalthealth.com/vendor-onboard/Redwood-Inference (you'll need to register with your corporate email). Once registered, upload the evidence and the completed PO template."

Marissa — can you own the evidence bundle and README? Tessa — can you run the SOW redline and check with legal if the uplift should be applied as a one-time amendment vs incremental billing?

Thanks — Rachel
